candidates.publisher: KIOS Research and Innovation Center of Excellence, University of Cyprus
candidates.annotation_type: YOLO format normalized bounding boxes (class 0: landing_pad)
candidates.target_description: Concentric circular landing pad with center marking
candidates.video_session_structure: Two continuous video capture sessions: 'land_pad' (frames 6025-6850) and 'land_pad2' (frames 0025-0675)

audit_result.primary_rejection_reason: All 422 frames originate from the exact same two flight sessions used for Phase 23 training and protected testing. Severe cross-split collision: embargo frame land_pad__6475.jpg and test frame land_pad__6500.jpg match at perceptual Hamming distance 4 (near-duplicate temporal autocorrelation). Not an independent capture campaign.

candidates.source: International Micro Air Vehicle Conference & Competition 2025

audit_result.primary_rejection_reason: Candidate imagery files, capture manifest, verifiable session IDs (session_id, source_video_id), physical target ontology documentation, and negative frame inventory have not been publicly released or archived. Pre-registered admission requires complete artifact verification before admission.

candidates.annotation_type: Pascal VOC XML and YOLO format
candidates.target_description: Cyan/Blue circular target with bold 'UAP' lettering and Red landing surface with white crescent emblem
candidates.video_session_structure: Unstructured individual image frames without continuous video identifiers

audit_result.primary_rejection_reason: Target class ontology mismatch: visual markers are competition specific emblems ('UAP' text, crescent) fundamentally distinct from KIOS concentric circles. The frozen Phase 22/23 YOLO11n detectors were trained strictly on concentric circles and cannot detect these symbols without retraining. Furthermore, session boundaries are absent.
audit_result.ontology_conflict: Emblem/text target vs concentric ring pattern

candidates.source: Rowan University Computer Vision Lab / FAA 5010 Airport Directory
candidates.capture_platform: Satellite / high-altitude aerial survey (Google Earth / USGS imagery)
candidates.target_description: Civilian and military full-scale hospital, airport, and rooftop helicopter landing zones ('H' painted on asphalt/concrete)
candidates.video_session_structure: Geographically indexed static orthophotos (zero video sequences)

audit_result.primary_rejection_reason: Massive domain and semantic mismatch: targets are permanent structural architecture for manned helicopters viewed at nadir satellite scale, rather than portable micro-UAV landing pads viewed during terminal descent. Extreme spatial scale gap and perspective mismatch.
audit_result.ontology_conflict: Permanent civil aviation infrastructure vs portable drone landing pad

candidates.dataset_name: Roboflow Universe Drone Landing Pad Datasets
candidates.license: Public Domain / CC BY 4.0 (unverified upload provenance)
candidates.target_description: Commercial foldable orange/blue fabric landing pads with large central 'H' and ArUco/AprilTag fiducial boards
candidates.video_session_structure: Random train/val/test splits of mixed frames without video session keys

audit_result.primary_rejection_reason: Target ontology mismatch: targets are commercial fabric 'H' pads or fiducial tags, incompatible with concentric circle detectors. Lack of verifiable capture session IDs, unknown negative frame inventory, and lack of verified physical provenance preclude rigorous admission.
audit_result.ontology_conflict: 'H' fabric markers and ArUco markers vs concentric circles

candidates.source: KIOS Unreal AirSim, PX4 Gazebo, UNM Crazyflie Webots
candidates.target_description: Virtual 3D textures of landing pads and markers

audit_result.primary_rejection_reason: Simulated computer graphics are excluded by definition from Phase 26 real-world external generalization. Phase 23 was already trained on synthetic AirSim data; testing on synthetic data cannot validate real-world physical generalization.
